subject.title: fix(media): keep hosted plugin media pinned

question: Does the current Gateway HTTP-route registry pin/release lifecycle intentionally own hosted-media resolvers for the whole pinned request surface?
rationale: The patch changes a runtime ownership boundary rather than merely adding a local media fallback, and the latest current-main implementation could not be independently inspected in this run.

options.title: Confirm and land
options.body: Confirm that hosted-media resolvers belong to the pinned HTTP-route registry and land the focused fix after the final merge refresh.

options.title: Keep active ownership
options.body: If hosted-media resolution is intentionally request-local, retain the active-registry lookup and define a different lifecycle-safe repair.

recommendation.title: Confirm and land
recommendation.body: Confirm that hosted-media resolvers belong to the pinned HTTP-route registry and land the focused fix after the final merge refresh.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the PR and are the clearest available recent participant in its current lifecycle state.
